facts.text: In 1965, E. A. Johnson of the Royal Radar Establishment in England developed a touch screen that could read only one touch at a time.
Johnson's touch technology was used for air traffic control in the United Kingdom until around 1995.
In the late 1960s, physicist Sam Hurst's experiments produced large amounts of paper chart records whose data had to be copied out by hand.
Hurst developed a sensor that could detect the position where it was pressed, and in 1971 he founded the company Elographics to sell it.
Hurst later turned the idea into a transparent screen, and his company became a leading supplier of touch screens for restaurants and stores.

In 1972, the University of Illinois PLATO IV terminal had an infrared touch panel that let students answer questions by touching the screen; it was the first touch screen widely used in Illinois classrooms.
PLATO students used terminals connected to a central computer, and the system had hundreds of terminals (950 by 1976).
In 1984, Bob Boie of Bell Labs developed the first multitouch screen, which let users move graphics with their fingers.
Transparent multitouch screens first became available to consumers around 2005, more than twenty years after Boie's screen.
IBM's Simon went on sale on August 16, 1994, and is widely regarded as the first smartphone.
Simon had no physical navigation buttons; users worked its touch screen mainly with a stylus, though a finger also worked.
Simon's battery lasted about one hour; it sold roughly 50,000 units and stayed on the market for about six months.
In 2007, Apple's iPhone became the first touch-screen smartphone to succeed in the market, and users could zoom photos by pinching.
Apple bought FingerWorks in 2005 and used its technology and staff to develop the iPhone.
From Johnson's 1965 screen to the 2007 iPhone is 42 years, roughly four decades.

notes: 混合題 mixed-advanced-05 第 1 組用（2026-10-09 線上查證，只取事實、不取原句）。NPR 把 Simon 記在 1993（發表），TIME 記 1994-08-16 開賣，選文用 1994。選文的「invisible light」指紅外線觸控面板；「hundreds of these screens were linked to a central computer」依 s4（1976 年 950 台終端機）。選文沒寫 Johnson 與 Hurst 的機構全名。
